Hi Engineering,

We are pleased to announce that ForenSightX v1.0 has been deployed to the production staging environment.
Key milestones achieved:
- 69 automated tests passing across CNN, BiLSTM, 7D Fusion ANN, and VAE modules.
- Interactive web dashboard running on port 8000 with Grad-CAM visual heatmaps.
- Full benchmark results accessible via /api/results_v10.

Documentation is available at: https://internal.company.internal/docs/forensightx

Regards,
Release Management Team

[10:00:15] Tech Lead: Good morning team! Let's kick off the daily sprint standup.
[10:01:02] Frontend Dev: Yesterday I finalized the responsive layout for the metrics cards. Today I am connecting the WebSocket status feed.
[10:02:10] Backend Dev: I reviewed the PR for the model checkpoint loading factory. All 69 unit tests passed cleanly with 0 errors.
[10:03:05] QA Lead: Automated test suites and smoke verification scripts ran in 10.9s on staging. All endpoints returned HTTP 200.
[10:04:00] Tech Lead: Excellent work. Let's merge the branch to master and prepare for the sprint demo at 2 PM. Who's joining for lunch?
